apps.name: AnimeToGMD
apps.short_description:
Anime to GD (A2GD) is a conversion tool for Geometry Dash.
It allows you to convert videos and images directly into the game using a vector approach to minimize objects (no AI).

apps.name: Bot Creator Studio
apps.short_description: Design, automate, and deploy bots seamlessly. With a visual block builder, and full scripting power, Bot Creator Studio brings command design, live monitoring, and hosting into a unified workspace—locally on your PC or 24/7 in the cloud.

apps.name: Desktop+
apps.short_description: Desktop+ is a utility application for SteamVR enabling you advanced access to your desktops and windows from within VR. Pull your screen into the VR world, attach windows to your controllers, view 3D content, and more.

apps.name: Forepaper Engine 前景引擎
apps.short_description: A fun window overlay software that supports audio visualization, Live2D animation, in-game overlays (keyboard/mouse control visualization, gamepad control visualization, custom game crosshair), dynamic screensavers, dynamic lock screens, window transparency, and more.

apps.name: Game Widgets
apps.short_description: Game Widgets combines customizable animated crosshairs, a screen magnifier with multiple modes, and an overlay whiteboard. Create crosshairs, magnify details, and display saved notes and map annotations on screen. Show or hide tools with hotkeys.

apps.name: I Ching: Chinese Tarot & Wisdom of Change
apps.short_description: I Ching — Chinese Tarot & Wisdom of Change is an interactive divination experience based on the 64 hexagrams of the ancient I Ching. Ask questions about love, career, study, choices, or the future, then explore your hexagram to reflect on change, timing, balance, and the paths ahead.

apps.name: Live2D VR Girls
apps.short_description:
With Live2D VR Girls, you can experience VR experience with lively animated characters by Live2D.
It is a game aimed at telling the charm of character expression with two scenarios and easy operation.

apps.name: LsletUI
apps.short_description:
Bring Life to Your Desktop: The Ultimate Floating Interaction Tool.
Don't Just Use Windows, Experience It with LsletUI.
Minimal Footprint, Maximum Style: Meet Your New Desktop Companion.

apps.name: Mythistoria
apps.short_description: Mythistoria is an all-in-one creative writing and world-building application built for novelists and storytellers alike to manage their process end-to-end.

apps.name: OVR Locomotion Effect
apps.short_description: "OVR Locomotion Effect" is an overlay tool that aims to reduce VR sickness. It displays anti-sickness effect to HMD by controller input. You can use this tool on any SteamVR games since the effect is displayed as an overlay in front of the game.

apps.name: Pixelithra
apps.short_description: Pixelithra is a pixel art editor for Windows. Draw sprites and backgrounds, create frame-by-frame animations and tilesets, and refine your artwork with editable curves, shapes, and linked fills.

apps.name: RPG Soundboard
apps.short_description: RPG Soundboard is an audio companion for tabletop RPG game masters, featuring a user interface designed for easier, live playback. Load your own music and sound effects, organize them across multiple soundboards and playlists, and increase the immersion of your table.
publishers: Luiz  Felipe Romero de Azevedo (indie solo dev)

apps.name: Screenbits - Screen Recorder
apps.short_description: Fast, flexible, and easy-to-use screen recorder for gameplay, tutorials, product demos, and more. Record your screen, system audio, microphone, and camera in high-quality HD or 4K with smooth performance.

apps.name: Unreal Musician
apps.short_description: Visualize, Learn, Compose And Render Music.

apps.name: VRCAT
apps.short_description: VRCAT's simple tool set will allow you to quickly sketch and model objects in VR.  No 3D modeling experience needed to sketch a building, a car, or a far away world.  Let your creativity flow.

apps.name: Walton's Window Sitters
apps.short_description: Simple desktop customizer that's not distracting, low on resource use, and extremely simple to use. Upload a gif, APNG, or just a static image and make your desktop feel even more like yours!

apps.name: Urine Trouble: PEE V PEE ™ Playtest
Dire Fog: Tactical Card Combat Playtest
$1 Pizza Slice Demo
apps.short_description: Try ten days in a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt.

apps.name: Alt-Tab Legend Demo
apps.short_description: Ever seen that guy at the internet café running eight games at once? Your turn. Build the PC, set up the keyboard, raise a few Keysprites to mash keys for you, and open more games every night. The demo covers the whole café; everything after you walk out a winner is in the full game!

apps.name: Ardent Wilds Demo
apps.short_description:
Dive into a fast-paced open-world survival crafting game built around flashy, arcade-style combat. 
Discover powerful spells and power-ups, experiment with character builds, and push your limits through increasingly dangerous environments and intense boss fights.

apps.name: Around Us Demo
apps.short_description: This is DEMO version of Around Us: Zombie Shooter. Which allows you to play local coop mode on few early waves. So you can see briefly what this game is about.

apps.name: Ashikai Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening hour of Ashikai, a dark fantasy isometric action RPG set in yōkai-cursed feudal Japan. Begin Matsuo Shinro's journey, master precise katana combat, take on quests, and enter the first dungeon.

apps.name: Astro Prospector Prologue
apps.short_description: Astro Prospector Prologue is an incremental bullet hell about mining cofferoids and fighting SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Return AstroCoffee to humanity!

apps.name: Ballgame Demo
apps.short_description: Aim, bounce, smash and grind your way through Ballgame, a ballsy physics platformer where you ARE the ball. Compete in challenging tournaments, speed-driven heists, and physics-bending courses where the precision of golf meets the speed of pinball!

apps.name: BARD'S FAULT Demo
apps.short_description: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

apps.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Brew your own beer from scratch! Take on the role of a brewmaster, learn brewing techniques, create unique recipes, and grow your craft brewery into a full-scale factory. Expand your brewery from mashing and fermenting to bottling and selling - every decision shapes your beer empire

apps.name: Blade & Burgers Demo
apps.short_description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

apps.name: BLIGHTEN Demo
apps.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

apps.name: Blood Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

apps.name: Bookish Buddies: Bookstore Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Manage a cozy bookstore with up to 4 friends! By day, stock shelves and serve customers. But beware the Night Shift—grab your magic wands to defend your shop against creatures and survive the hilarious chaos in this unique co-op simulator.

apps.name: BREAKOUT BABY Demo
apps.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

apps.name: Bullet Glory Demo
apps.short_description: Play Bullet Glory’s Circuit with the Arrow: three neon stages, their bosses and every difficulty. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Chain-Chillas Demo
apps.short_description: A 3D marble rolling game where you're chained to your friends!

apps.name: Corsair Cove Demo
apps.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

apps.name: Crash Cut Demo
apps.short_description: A voxel rally where every wall is a shortcut and every car a target. Punch car-sized holes through houses, barns and brick walls, ram the pack off the road, and race a six-round knockout to the title, or take one battered hull through a roguelite run.

apps.name: Dead Sector Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

apps.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew Demo
apps.short_description: In this incremental game, scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

apps.name: Deal Me In Demo
apps.short_description: A PS1-inspired casino horror roguelike. Play slots and draw poker, open upgrade packs, pay your growing debt, and escape the Backrooms. Survive six days on Easy in this single-player demo of Deal Me In.

apps.name: Death Howl Demo
apps.short_description: Journey the sorrowful spirit world in soulslike deck builder, Death Howl. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

apps.name: Decks of Dexterity Demo + Friend Pass
DELTA // SURGE Demo
apps.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

apps.name: Desktop Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Drill deep while you work or game in a zero-stress factory builder for the side of your screen or second monitor. Power your drill, unlock alternate building shapes, and master compact layouts as you harvest the galaxy. The. Factory. Must. Grow.

apps.name: Draco and the Seven Scales Demo
apps.short_description: Set sail on a voyage full of pirates, dark magic, and the thrill of discovery! Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that harkens back to an age of top down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art.

apps.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered DEMO
apps.short_description:
A demo of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered.
Experience a special demo version of the Battle of Hulao Gate while playing as Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Xiahou Dun, Zhen Ji, Zhou Yu, and Sun Shangxiang.

apps.name: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

apps.name: Figure Drawing Garden Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden — an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

apps.name: GODBREAKERS Demo
apps.short_description: Take control of every fight with ferociously fluid combat as you chain aggressive combos, cancel moves mid-swing, and steal enemy powers to turn them against their masters. Play in up to 4-player co-op to craft the perfect team setup and topple brutal bosses across different worlds.

apps.name: Gravelix Demo
apps.short_description: Try Gravelix for free: blocks shatter into gravel on landing, and same-colored gravel that reaches from one side of the board to the other explodes. The demo includes the interactive tutorial and Classic mode with 5-minute sessions limitation.

apps.name: GunBlocks Demo
apps.short_description: Move tetrominos to shape the terrain, blast enemies, and survive a chaotic crew with your over-eager ship AI, H.A.P.P.Y., on a hostile, mysterious planet.

apps.name: Heart Duels Demo
apps.short_description: Uncover the mystery of the Tower of Kardun in a story-driven adventure through Erisa. Master tactical card duels where positioning matters as much as power. Discover the world’s lore, dismantle cards, and craft custom cards to build a deck that brings your strategy to life.

apps.name: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder Demo
apps.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

apps.name: Hustle Together Demo
apps.short_description: Hustle together is a top down space action-RPG for 1-4 players.  Hustle for bling by scavenging, salvaging, hunting and trading.  Spend bling on upgrades for your ship, or over 100 upgradeable weapons.

apps.name: Idle Ascent Demo
apps.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

apps.name: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey Demo
apps.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

apps.name: Keystrike Demo
apps.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

apps.name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM Episode One Demo
apps.short_description:
"The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..."

KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

apps.name: Lost Floor — Not My World Demo
Magical Princess Demo
apps.short_description: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

apps.name: Mailstrom: Demo Day
apps.short_description: Join a co-op team of 4 friends in a first person shooter that sends Pan Galactic Postal Service letter carriers into the locked-down streets of the future! Fight mutated alien horrors as you and your fellow essential workers deliver baubles to hard-to-find destinations! Hey, at least it's a job!

apps.name: Mall Chaos Demo
apps.short_description: Your shift starts when the mall closes. Explore shoe shops, cosmetics stores, and sports shops in Mall Chaos Demo. Pick up scattered products, carry them through the aisles, and return them to the right displays in this first-person tidying game.

apps.name: MENACE Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.

apps.name: One More Jackpot! Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first three in-game days of ONE MORE JACKPOT! Bring a dying arcade back to life in this active incremental: play the machines yourself, earn coins, and start upgrading your arcade.

apps.name: Pelican Empyrean Demo
apps.short_description: Food is love! In this fantastical roguelike card game share the magic of abundance by cooking delicious meals for all who come to King Pelican's kitchen.

apps.name: Pinhead Adventures Demo
apps.short_description: Swing, blast, and grapple your way around in the Pinhead Adventures DEMO! The Zino is Zortan's very own Casino! Spin the Slots! Gather the coins! Spawn ferocious enemies. Get powerful in this randomized sandbox! Solve puzzles? Easy! Experience low gravity in the Pinhead Adventures DEMO! Play Today!

apps.name: Pixel Composer Demo
apps.short_description: Demo version of Pixel Composer gives you full access to the full version, without the ability to save/load projects, use export nodes (right-click to save is enabled), or use Steam workshop.

apps.name: Pizzapoly Demo
apps.short_description: PIZZAPOLY Demo is a chaotic co-op restaurant game where you run your own pizzeria with friends. Prepare pizzas, serve tables, handle online orders, hop on your scooter for deliveries, and survive the rush together.

apps.name: Planet Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Planet Sim is a factory and colony builder on a procedural generated planet. Your colony ship broke apart in orbit, and you land with a rover, a lander and a plan. This demo is the start of that journey, with no time limit, plus two short previews of the late game.

apps.name: PluggedInCats Demo
apps.short_description: Demo — Battery running low! Place the cats and route their cables with care to charge every device and keep these internet-loving kitties exploring the digital world!

apps.name: Pocket Ocean Demo
apps.short_description: Sway your mermaid fin and dive towards the lake bed to collect pretty pebbles! Customize your merperson, upgrade your skills, trade with trinket-obsessed crows and explore the waters. Dock the game in the corner of your screen so it can keep you company  as you do other things!

apps.name: Pocket TD Demo
apps.short_description: Try Pocket TD free: a tower defense game on a map that grows as you play. Play the tutorial and a full Expedition with four towers, and bring your XP and unlocks to the full game.

apps.name: Remember Us Demo
apps.short_description: “Who are you?” The most painful question one could hear at the end of a fifty-year love story. *Remember Us* is an emotional journey you embark on to bring back every memory Dean has forgotten and to help him remember his wife once again.

apps.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart Demo
apps.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

apps.name: ROBOSCAV Demo
apps.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

apps.name: Rock Diver Demo
apps.short_description:
Land, mine, fill your pack, and head back to your ship.
Become a Rock Diver in this incremental adventure as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and greet the locals along the way.

apps.name: Rodina Demo
apps.short_description: A single-developer passion project. A seamless full scale solar system. Thrilling action. Be part of an incredible journey as a Universe is built from the ground up!

apps.name: Rose Academy Demo
apps.short_description: In this detective visual novel, you play as a young agent sent to an elite girls' academy to investigate the suspicious death of a top student. Interrogate suspects, collect evidence, and build romantic relationships — will you uncover the truth or fall for someone's charm?

apps.name: Ruptured Floor Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into a surreal and dark office space made of distorted floors. Traverse them all, one at the time, to find an exit. Ruptured Floor is a horror puzzle game with a unique twist. Every floor requires a combination to open the door. The code is known. The lock, however, will need to be found.

apps.name: Sanity Shooter Demo
apps.short_description: A surreal boomer shooter where you fight through bizarre dimensions, master fast-paced combat, and adapt your tactics to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

apps.name: Scraplings Demo
apps.short_description: Build a cozy, hand-drawn factory on an endless sea of trash. Dig up scrap, lay belts, power your machines and turn yesterday's garbage into orders worth paying the rent with. This free demo covers your first seven days on the junk sea.

apps.name: SlashZero Demo
apps.short_description:
SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. 
As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! 
Is what you see the truth?

apps.name: Soggy Beans Demo
apps.short_description: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

apps.name: Sparrow Demo
apps.short_description: You are a sparrow trapped inside a mansion of unnatural horrors. Your babies have wandered into its walls and their cries have faded into darkness. Navigate vents, crawlspaces, and hidden rooms to uncover the mansion's secrets and find your children... before something else does.

apps.name: Splatchinko Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic pixel-art pachinko roguelike! Throw your EYES at hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations, and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

apps.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine Demo
apps.short_description: Spend a summer evening at an old captain’s house on the Maine coast. Explore the house and shore, fish from the dock, and collect sea glass as daylight fades into blue hour. Stay as long as you like.

apps.name: Summoner Arise Demo
apps.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined temple. Run out and you lose. With hundreds of upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

apps.name: Super Piotr Deluxe Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into the complete gameplay loop of Super Piotr Deluxe: Explore the first level theme, master procedural runs, and unleash six different weapons against enemy hordes precision platforming meets neon bullet-heaven chaos!

apps.name: Survivors Under Siege Demo
apps.short_description: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

apps.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon Demo
apps.short_description: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.

apps.name: The Granny Detective Society Demo
apps.short_description:
Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the
CIA… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions,
and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of
tea.

apps.name: The King's Muster Demo
apps.short_description: The whole first Mark of The King's Muster: thirty battles on the Meadow, from the first skirmish to a siege at the gates of the Mark's castle, plus the sandbox with up to 2,000 men. Your campaign carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Time Stop Tower Defense Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

apps.name: Trust Your Gut Demo
apps.short_description: A rogue-lite roulette game. Born unlucky; your life is tied to this game. To survive, buy mementos you want, bend the odds, and return to each spin a little stronger.

apps.name: Tungsteel Demo
apps.short_description: Build deadly mech squads in a single-player autobattler with a turn-based strategy map. Combine abilities, set target priorities, and cut enemy supply lines. Capture resources to repair, rearm, and unlock new mechs as you push toward the enemy base.

apps.name: TurtleSkate Demo
apps.short_description: Skate as a turtle, complete objectives, avoid entities, and escape. 1-5 player co-op horror.

apps.name: Two & Two: Agents Demo
apps.short_description: Become a secret-agent duo in a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Investigate a strange experiment, exchange clues across different perspectives, and talk your way through puzzles neither agent can solve alone.

apps.name: Wizard Tournament Demo
apps.short_description: Wizard Tournament is a tower-building autobattler where every run is a puzzle of placement, economy, and magical item synergies.Dive into the free demo,  giving you the chance experience every element of the game with only ranked and co-op mode disabled.

apps.name: Yaarmi Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Play Yaarmi's first day for free: the tutorial in his messy bedroom and the whole first studio. Buy gear, upgrade every part, complete missions and watch your income grow in this cozy idle tycoon. Progress is saved. 7 languages.

apps.name: You Remembered Demo
apps.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

apps.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE Demo
apps.short_description: The system says you did it. Prove otherwise. Build a deck of mythic Archetypes and hacker Protocols, capture a 4×4 board, and follow the evidence through the Darknet bazaar. This free demo includes two starting approaches and one Enclave.

apps.name: Zombie Cropse Demo
apps.short_description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

apps.name: Сердце Урала Demo
apps.short_description: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.

apps.name: Токарь: Ночная Смена Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person lathe simulator. Work the night shift: control speed and feed, machine parts to drawings, check dimensions and complete jobs. Smoke breaks, alcohol and a sharp-tongued mentor liven up the routine, while carelessness leads to injuries and fires.

apps.name: ねこ天下～三国志パチンコタイピングで轟かす～ Demo
小人物的逆袭：期权游戏 试玩版
我的幸福人生 Demo
apps.short_description: Kevin dies in a car crash and wakes up in a strange new world filled with gentle wives, cool mature women, and cute girls. He also meets many beauties—teachers, doctors, police officers, nurses, and streamers. Can he find happiness in this new life?

apps.name: 敏感！恋のアンテナ ビンビン別嬪荘 Demo
apps.short_description:
Co-produced by TV Asahi and Aiming, this “drama-level” live-action romance game lets you experience a year of love, laughter, and longing.
Decode the subtle signals of affection and create your own unforgettable love story.

apps.name: 老板说问题不大 Demo
apps.short_description: 睁开眼，面前是一张符纸，一条闹鬼的巷子，一个委托，以及…一位不靠谱的无良老板。躲藏、交涉、收集线索，在谎言中寻找真相，诙谐与惊悚交织。当死亡也成为武器，一次次带着轮回的记忆重新来过，而这次，你走向的结局是…？

apps.name: 通幽镇 Demo
apps.short_description: A town that runs itself. You decide who ventures out, where they go, and what the town sells. Recruit, form squads, farm regions, craft gear, and run the market — the rest happens without you.

apps.name: 阎王叫我三更死，我把阎王打半死 Demo
apps.short_description:
"Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead"
Sort souls. Build decks. Beat up Ox-Head! Experience a bizarre first-person workplace sim + card battler featuring retro claymation and over-the-top FMV.

apps.name: 音序核心 Demo
apps.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

apps.name: ARK Tides of Fortune
apps.short_description: Build & customize your ships, and set sail for adventure across the high-seas this massive ARK gameplay expansion! Explore an uncharted ocean frontier to hunt for buried treasure, tame deep-sea monstrosities, and battle ruthless pirate armadas in PvE & PvP!

apps.name: Borderlands®4 - Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort
apps.short_description: Fight alongside FL4K to hunt down Tediore forces invading the tropical island of Providence! This wild adventure features new missions, activities, loot, and a lush new region.

apps.name: Bureau Clerk Goes Berserk! [An Additional Lap of the Gods Tale]
apps.short_description: After the events of Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel, Beau the Bureau Clerk is recovering from her buggy incident. But when Marion calls up Beau to apologize and offers a date, how could Beau possibly say no?! Join Beau as she gets ready for a fun-filled night with the one and only Marion! 💜

apps.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II - DMZ Beta
apps.short_description: Fight against players and AI enemies as you pick a hitlist of missions with your squad. Once you’ve hit your limit, find a chopper and exfil to safety - or fight to be the squad that claims the final ride out.

apps.name: DCS: F-16C Viper Red Flag 21-1 Campaign
apps.short_description: The Red Flag 21-1 Campaign is the result of painstaking research on the conduct of modern Large Force Exercises (LFE). Scenarios, procedures, target sites and threats are based on those used in the real Red Flag.

This campaign guides the player through a gripping storyline about a PMC pilot named Vitalii Gerasimov.

Classic win-win situation if you ask us.

apps.name: Devil's Island-DLC

apps.name: Idle Cultivator: Supporter Pack

apps.name: Idle King: Supporter Pack

apps.name: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Woodburn Weapon Skin Set

apps.name: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Prehistoric East

apps.name: PAYDAY 2: VR

apps.name: Pioneers of Pagonia - Meadowsong
apps.short_description: Experience the story of the island »Meadowsong«. Once known for their thriving agriculture, the harvest of Meadowsong is haunted by a mysterious Withering destroying everything. Build new production chains with fruits, wine and livestock, and help to solve the mystery of the witches' coven.

apps.name: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness
apps.short_description:
Experience a new story around Radjen, the assassin of the Immortals, as she traps Sargon in her Mind Palace, a nightmarish dimension created with her dark magic.
Explore four biomes filled with new platforming elements, new lethal foes to face, and three epic bosses.

apps.name: RPG Maker MV - POP! Horror City
apps.short_description: This stylish and pulp-fiction inspired pack contains a large mix of tiles and characters, conveniently bundled together for an affordable price.

apps.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
apps.short_description: The Deluxe Edition Upgrade for RuneScape: Dragonwilds comes with a range of exclusive cosmetic and decorative items for you as you carve out a foothold in this magical new frontier in the world of RuneScape. Placeable decorations, pet beds and alternative cosmetics for craftable in-game gear await!

apps.name: Session: Skate Sim El Lay
apps.short_description: Welcome to El Lay – where the sun and the sand meet the grit of the big city. Come shred our homage to some of the most iconic skateparks on the West Coast.

apps.name: Skeleton Empire-DLC

The Skeleton Empire DLC adds a brand-new playable faction to Crowns and Colossi: tireless bone infantry, necromancers, undead cavalry, and the scythe-wielding Grim Reaper colossus, with a new faction skill and an exclusive story campaign.

apps.name: SOS OPS! - OVERBOOKED
apps.short_description: OVERBOOKED is a DLC for SOS OPS! that adds a new co-op flight scenario for up to 4 players. Prepare the plane, load baggage, seat passengers, handle in-flight problems, fly the aircraft and land safely together.

apps.name: Soulstonia - Save Slot Expansion

apps.name: Soulstonia - Summoner Expansion

apps.name: Soulstonia - Supporter Pack

apps.name: Succubus - Issabel Cosplay

apps.name: Succubus - Red Goddess
apps.short_description: A huge expansion for Succubus, which expands the plot of the game and allows you to play as the Red Goddess!

apps.name: Super Meat Boy Race Mode
apps.short_description: You know how you have that one annoying friend who would always be like "I'm so much better at Super Meat Boy than you" and "If we could race I would destroy you!" well guess what, get some potato chips, grab some controllers, and reluctantly call that friend over so you can shove his undeserving feelings of superiority over you into his dumb stupid face!

apps.name: Supporter Pack: Cycle of the First Dawn - Visions of the Realms
apps.short_description: An optional supporter artwork collection for Cycle of the First Dawn, featuring themed wallpapers, four realm atlases, a Tea Master illustration, and an Upper Realm entity study. Created with AI assistance under the developer's direction; no gameplay content.

apps.name: Supporter+
apps.short_description: Shampoo quality of life brought in a small bundle

apps.name: Tea Garden Pinball
apps.short_description: 🏗️ Build towering skyscrapers, operate giant cranes, smash through demolition zones, and conquer steel ramps, spinners, bumpers, and drop targets! 🚜🔨 Trigger explosive multiball action, complete massive construction projects, and score huge jackpots in this heavy-duty pinball adventure!

apps.name: TEKKEN 8 - Kunimitsu
apps.short_description: The Enchanted Thief - Kunimitsu the Second is joining the fight!

apps.name: THE BACKLOG - Heart Collection
apps.short_description: A love antenna hat and a set of heart effects. Thrown games fly like Cupid's arrows, and a love letter floats up every time you shelve one. Put your love for games into every tidy-up.

apps.name: THE BACKLOG - Sparkle Collection
apps.short_description: A bright-idea bulb hat and a set of sparkling effects. Thrown games leave a sparkle comet trail, and a light bulb pops above your head every time you shelve one. A little extra shine for your tidying.

apps.name: The Bible - AI Narration (Bark TTS)
apps.short_description: Tired of using your inner voice to read? Are you blind like me? Try the new AI Narration DLC for The Bible! It's totally free, and it allows you to get high quality human-like narration for your preferred translation of The Bible.

apps.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Plus Membership
apps.short_description: Become an ESO Plus member to unlock brand-new seasonal benefits, increased progression, a Crown Store stipend, and more!

apps.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Lokhir Fellheart
apps.short_description: Lokhir Fellheart, the Krakenlord of Karond Kar, is loosed upon the world! The latest and most notorious of his line, he plies the coastlines and seaways of the world, plundering ports and settlements for their riches and enslaving their inhabitants.

apps.name: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator - BUG DLC
apps.short_description:
Bugs are awesome, we have too few of them, we made some more.

This DLC includes 11 unique bugs that you can trigger in the options menu!

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 1
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: Dallas, San Antonio and Miami skylines, Acorn Street in Boston, Bryce Canyon in snow and empty roads across the prairie. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 2
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: the New River Gorge Bridge, Manhattan from above, the Biloxi lighthouse, a mountain town in the fall and desert arches. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 3
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: El Capitan, the Painted Hills, the Big Sur coast, a barn below the Tetons, Charleston and Las Vegas from above. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 4
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: an old mill above the falls, golden leaves in a brick alley, Zion's river, the Austin and Tampa skylines and Atlanta at sunset. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: War Thunder - Air Forces High-res Texture Pack
apps.short_description: This high-resolution texture pack will improve your War Thunder gaming experience without degrading FPS!

apps.name: WARDOGS - Movember Pack
apps.short_description: Grow a Mustache for charity! WARDOGS is teaming up with Movember to support men's health. Grab the Tactical ‘Stache DLC, grow your moustache as you play throughout November, and unlock a permanent Movember 2026 scoreboard badge. 100% of profits from this DLC go to Movember.

apps.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class Cosmetic Upgrade
apps.short_description: You are justice. The Adeptus Arbites enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law. Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.

apps.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Processional of the Damned
apps.short_description: “Processional of the Damned” is the fourth story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, featuring a new companion, the Zealot archetype, and a journey into a procession of lost ships trapped in orbit around a turbulent star.

apps.name: Your Sweet Little Kitty - Furball & Wardrobe Collection
apps.short_description:
Level up your cozy time with your cat!

This DLC brings idle hairball harvesting and deeper bonding surprises. Enjoy 150+ accessories with 6,000+ style combos, a gacha and crafting system, and 36 collection logs to complete!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Carbon Weapon Skins
apps.short_description: Yes, it comes in black! Apply a carbon look to your guns with these weapon skins

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Flags Charm Pack
apps.short_description: Let the undead know who sent you! With these flag charms, you can add some patriotic spirit to your guns!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Gas Mask Headgear Bundle
apps.short_description: Now that the legions of the undead have laid waste to Europe, fears of poisonous gasses are a thing of the past. However, the masks themselves have been repurposed as protective headgear

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Left 4 Dead Character Pack 1
apps.short_description: The four characters from Left 4 Dead join the Resistance in this free Character Pack!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Wehrmacht P08 Pistol Bundle
apps.short_description: It’s time to bring a new meaning to ‘point and shoot!’ One of the most accurate guns ever made, this semi-automatic pistol has a fearsome reputation for a reason!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Wrapping Paper Weapon Skins
apps.short_description: Give the undead hordes the gift of destruction! Apply a wrapping paper look to your guns with these weapon skins.

apps.name: 方块方舟 - 地下迷城
apps.short_description: Terracrypt is PixARK’s first major underground expansion. Your ship is shot down. A broken distress signal pulls you into strange biomes, ruthless enemies, and a hidden conspiracy beneath the surface—where your choices may decide the fate of an entire world.

apps.name: $1 Pizza Slice
apps.short_description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

apps.name: (tidy up) The Bone Prince's Party Palace
apps.short_description: Steal coins, buy magic, steal more coins, buy more magic, 1-4 players online. There's at least 1,000,000 coins but probably closer to like 25,000,000 by the time we get done here.

apps.name: 10 Million Stones
apps.short_description: This game is being rebuilt from the ground up. A new name, new visuals and a full description will be posted here when they are ready.

apps.name: 4Way: Driving
apps.short_description: A challenging arcade racing game with the goal of setting high scores.

apps.name: 85Top
apps.short_description:
85Top is an arcade racing game inspired by Crazy Taxi, with the fast pace of Need for Speed ​​and the heat of downtown Fortaleza!
Pick up passengers, compete with other app drivers, earn money and get a 5-star rating — all this with passing through historic landmarks in the city.

apps.name: A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS
apps.short_description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

apps.name: A Week to Remember
apps.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, boys' love visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

apps.name: Aetherlob
apps.short_description: Follow a rumor of a star that never goes out in this turn-based artillery roguelite. Read the wind, time charged shots and blast through terrain. Recruit companions across five layers, combine weapons and relics, and play solo or in online and LAN co-op.

apps.name: Age of Dynasty & Dust
apps.short_description: From the fall of Troy in 1200 BC to 1941, the whole Old World on one map. Rule one city, outlive your rivals, and pass the throne down two or three generations — 46 scenarios, 80 cities and 6,608 real historical figures. Not one of them is invented.

apps.name: Alex's Journey to the Grave
apps.short_description: Two people meet in a strange, critical moment; changing their lives forever. An intimate visual novel exploring the nature of love, fate, tragedy, and the will to live on.

apps.name: ALL HANDS LOST
apps.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

apps.name: Allegedly Innocent: Justice for Sale
apps.short_description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

apps.name: Alt-Tab Legend
apps.short_description: Ever seen that guy at the internet café running eight games at once? Your turn. Build the PC, set up the keyboard, raise a few Keysprites to mash keys for you, and open more games every night. You'll walk out of the café a winner, and there's a lot more waiting for you after that!

apps.name: Altertum
apps.short_description: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.

apps.name: Americana: The Dead Years
apps.short_description: Fight zombies and hostile survivors in a first-person voxel survival sandbox. Scavenge fallen towns, repair vehicles and smash through destructible buildings. Build a home, rebuild bridges, hunt, fish and farm to stay alive.

apps.name: An Amazing Wizard: Prologue
apps.short_description: An Amazing Wizard is a 2D fast-paced metroidvania-inspired spell-slinging roguelike where you'll create spells. Master 7 elemental and merge 120 unique spells in any order to create endless possibilities. Choose from 250 perks. Explore 250 artifacts. Collect your lost memories and reclaim true name!

apps.name: Angels Cove: Awake
apps.short_description: Trapped in a decaying 1970s psychiatric hospital, Jackie Moore searches for the truth about his mother. Examine physical clues, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the institution's secrets in this first-person psychological horror mystery.

apps.name: Anime Shop Sort Together
apps.short_description: Tidy up a chaotic Akihabara anime figure shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players! Grab stacks of boxed figures, find the right shelf, toss them into place and unlock team skills. Every figure in its place. Together.

apps.name: Anomaly Planet
apps.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

apps.name: AntiClimatic
apps.short_description: A physics based weather simulator where you change the weather patterns throughout 30+ scenarios.

apps.name: Arcane Ligature
apps.short_description: Arcane Ligature is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where you create your own spells by combining runes. Experiment with powerful fusions, master strategic turn-based combat, collect magical relics and battle through an ever-changing world where every run brings new possibilities.

apps.name: Arcane Whispers: The Last Stand
apps.short_description: Step into the role of Zephon, the last Guardian, in this third-person action-adventure. Harness the powers of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, carefully managing each element as you battle elemental foes, solve puzzles, and explore a shattered world of floating islands.

apps.name: Aria's Canvas
apps.short_description: The game follows a character struggling with anxiety and depression, moving through a dark, gloomy world. They collect power-ups representing mental health coping strategies such as exercise, problem solving or humour, gradually making the world brighter and smoother.

apps.name: Ascension Trail: Idle Crusade
apps.short_description: Your heroes fight. You choose the path. Recruit a party from nine roles, gear them up, and pair clashing elements for devastating combos in an idle auto-battler about the decisions between fights.

apps.name: Ashfield Hollow
apps.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

apps.name: ASHGATE
apps.short_description: An adult harem visual novel. You wake up in a prison built into a volcano, in the body of a famous thief, with the Queen's stolen necklace around your neck. It won't come off. Pit night is in seven days. Every character is voiced and every sex scene is animated.

apps.name: Asteria 4X
apps.short_description: A turn-based 4X space strategy game in the tradition of Stars! (1995). Design your race and starships, settle everything from asteroid belts to black holes, face Star Trek inspired dilemmas, and conquer a random galaxy against AI empires.

apps.name: Astral Wizards
apps.short_description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Ayakashi Profile
apps.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

apps.name: Babelled
apps.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

apps.name: Backup Boy: Office
apps.short_description: An adult turn-based card battler with office comedy and flirting. Build your deck, combine cards, and choose conversation topics to outplay six heroines. Tackle six mini-games, earn reward cards, and test your strategies in Arena Draft and Trials.

apps.name: Ball Pit Cleanup
apps.short_description: Sort thousands of colorful balls into matching pipes. Unlock upgrades and work more efficiently, but be careful: every mistake adds more balls to the pile.

apps.name: Bare Metal Billionaire
apps.short_description: An idle game for people with jobs. A pixel-art data center sits in the corner of your desktop and quietly makes you a billionaire. If anyone asks, you're monitoring the servers.

apps.name: Battlebound Rumble
apps.short_description: Build your warband, pull off ridiculous combos, and show your rivals what perfect build can do! A free-to-play PvP autobattler with 18+ heroes, hundreds of minions, powerful spells, and battles where one brilliant idea can turn the whole match around!

apps.name: Battles of Helaman
apps.short_description: Command the Nephites or Lamanites in Battles of Helaman, a turn-based strategy wargame inspired by the Book of Mormon. Fight across hex-based battlefields using tactical cards, terrain, and distinctive Faith or Wickedness abilities to gain the advantage.

apps.name: Beats of Fate
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate team, master strategic turn-based combat, and challenge players around the world in intense PvP battles. Fight solo in 1v1 duels or team up for thrilling 2v2 battles!

apps.name: Beekeeper Simulator
apps.short_description: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

apps.name: Blades & Dates
apps.short_description: Fight hot warrior girls in this fantasy card battler. Strip them in battle, win them over, and earn the reward you came for. Explosive combos, mini-games, and horny adventures await!

apps.name: Blades For Hire
apps.short_description: Blades for Hire is a captivating strategy game where you lead a mercenary guild. Dive into the story of a man fighting for survival, facing daily choices between morality and pragmatism. Guide your guild to prosperity—or ruin—as you navigate the harsh realities of a mercenary’s life.

apps.name: Blame Echoes
apps.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

apps.name: Blocia
apps.short_description: Blocia is a multiplayer sandbox  MMO where you can build, explore, create games, collect items, customize your character, and connect with players in worlds made by the community.

apps.name: Blood Is Due
apps.short_description: BID: Blood Is Due is a psychological horror roguelite where you face four deadly games of chance. Roll the dice, build your deck, manage Blood, exploit Dealer passives, choose your route, and risk more for greater rewards.

apps.name: Blood Ties - Legacy
apps.short_description: An adult visual novel of vampire politics. Born into one of the Seven bloodlines that rule from the shadows, you’re called home to claim an inheritance everyone wants a piece of. Branching story, a large cast of women with their own agendas, and choices that matter. 18+.

apps.name: Boardgame Nights
apps.short_description: Boardgame Nights is a 3D board game collection with 16 games. Play alone or online with up to 8 players!

apps.name: Bonded in Darkness
apps.short_description: Fall in love with your worst enemy in this gothic vampire romance BL visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning to trust each other.

apps.name: Bookish Buddies: Bookstore Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and manage your cozy dream bookstore cafe alone or with friends! Unpack book deliveries, curate bestsellers & rare antique finds, brew warm coffee, pet your sleepy boxy cat, and expand your charming multi-floor shop in this delightful online co-op simulator.

apps.name: Break Of Dawn
apps.short_description: A hex-grid tower defense deck builder. Every card places a building, every rank is paid for in enemies taken alive or destroyed in battle, and between waves you pick which enemy type joins the army marching on you. Thirty waves, ten lives, and one tower per run that you can crown.

apps.name: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者
apps.short_description: This is a fast-paced roguelike hack-and-slash game where weapons, characters, and skills can all be developed independently and freely combined to create your very own build!

apps.name: Brutal War
apps.short_description: A game of dark humor and political and social satire. Crude and realistic references in a 3D first-person shooter. Prepare to see some very strange things in this strange game. LET'S KILL THE NAZIS TOGETHER!

apps.name: BULLETHEART
apps.short_description: In BULLETHEART, every enemy is a bullet. Learn the layouts, master the mechanics, and augment yourself to achieve victory with style.

apps.name: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning
apps.short_description: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning is a third-person bullet hell shooter. Join Cosmo Clean Co.'s Special Cleaning Division, drop onto high-risk planets, and recover the planet cores a former operative stole. Absorb incoming fire, slow the field with Time Dilation, and hit glowing weak points.

apps.name: Can't Escape It
apps.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

apps.name: Car Wash Crew
apps.short_description: Run a roadside car wash solo or with up to 3 friends. Blast mud, spread foam and build new bays by hand. Customers bring cars, buses, rugs—and the occasional house. Follow their tickets, split the work and try to keep your crew out of the soap.

apps.name: Caroline's Underworld
apps.short_description: Navigate through a weird and whimsical underworld, meet curious creatures and undead spirits, and solve puzzles to uncover the way forward. Caroline's Underworld is a 2D puzzle RPG with digitally hand-drawn assets that explores loneliness, friendship, and discovering one's true self.

apps.name: Cast & Cottage — 물가의 작은 집
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop companion fishing game along the bottom of your screen while you work, study, or browse. Let automatic fishing run or take the rod yourself. Collect lake and harbor fish, decorate your cottage and aquarium, and preserve your catches as ink prints.

apps.name: Catoptrum
apps.short_description: Each card is dealt face down. Clues, Divination, Tools and your own intuition will help you determine its rank and suit. Earn gold with every correct guess and Deck Challenge completed. Guard your lives and face off against the Six Trials on your way to the Final Fifty-Two. Can you divine the cards?

apps.name: Charmbound
apps.short_description: An adult idle clicker. Tap each girl to fill her gauge and unlock three ever-bolder pictures, then spend Crystals on uncensored CGs and animated scenes. 622 girls, 2,500+ images and 129 animated scenes to collect, with upgrades, auto-play and offline progress, so you never hit a wall.

apps.name: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
apps.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

apps.name: Checkpoint '38
apps.short_description: You're a German border guard in 1938. Check passports, catch forged papers, and decide who crosses as the rules tighten. Then go home and face your family. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise. Free demo on Steam.

apps.name: Choo Choo Kingdom
apps.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

apps.name: CHROMA CALM: Ego Death
apps.short_description: A twin-stick shooter about the arithmetic of ego. Kill to fill the Ego Gauge, climb four tiers to Hyper-Drive, and watch a 244-colour vector arena tear itself apart around you. Die, reincarnate, and carry the lineage forward. Or take the Hyper Scale and never stop.

apps.name: Chrono Cards
apps.short_description: Chrono Cards is a fast-paced, multiplayer competitive card game where you have the power to bend time itself! Build history-spanning decks and construct explosive, timeline-shattering combos. Exploit endless synergies to shape the timeline in your favor and send your opponent back to the stone age.

apps.name: CHUM Fishing
apps.short_description:
CHUM Fishing is a cooperative multiplayer horror fishing game. As alien caretakers assigned to these terrifying waters, you and your friends must catch enough monstrous fish to feed the unknown beings lurking beneath the surface.
But their appetites grow larger with each passing day.

apps.name: Citrus Tower
apps.short_description: Citrus Tower is a 24-player Cyberdelic Action RPG taking place in a randomly generated tower. The goal is simple: get to the top, or die trying.

apps.name: Claw Machine Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own claw machine shop! Order plushies, restock machines, welcome customers, and grow your business. Visit your rival's shop to play claw machines, collect plushies, and unlock new prizes and machines in this first-person shop management sim.

apps.name: Clawuuudy
apps.short_description: Your computer only needs one AI desktop pet. Clawuuudy joins you at work with the AI tools you already use, then shares your downtime through chat, care, odd jobs, idle adventures, and AI-powered stories.

apps.name: Clocklooped: Prison 12
apps.short_description: Trapped in a nightmarish police station where everything feels like a bad dream. Explore a looping corridor, spot and report strange anomalies, and encounter disturbing events and unexpected jumpscares. Can you find a way out?

apps.name: Coin Fall
apps.short_description: Coin Fall is a short coin pusher incremental game. Every coin helps you unlock new pushers and chase jackpots. Discover special coins and trigger bonus mini-games, all in pursuit of the ultimate ticket prize!

apps.name: Collabulator
apps.short_description:
Collaborative Calculation has never been easier!
Streamlined functionality meets masterful efficiency in the world’s FIRST and ONLY multi-user calculator.
Now with Achievements!

apps.name: Colorways
apps.short_description: Colorways is a minimalist traffic management game in which you help colorful traffic navigate various intersections while avoiding traffic jams and accidents. Unique modifiers and daily challenges present ever-changing levels and opportunities to climb the leaderboards.

apps.name: CombatBox: Reboot
apps.short_description: A large-scale war with hundreds of soldiers on one map, on an ordinary PC. Smart AI fills your squad and the enemy's: they talk over the radio, flank and rescue downed friends. Tanks, helicopters, jets and bombers share the battlefield. Build your own soldiers and squads, add anything with mods.

apps.name: Common Sense Rewrite Simulator
apps.short_description: Use the hypnisis app to do naughty things with Ayaka, a college student, and train her to become increasingly promiscuous.  Ask her out on a date, confess your feelings, and aim for a passionate relationship and intimate moments together.

apps.name: Corebreaker: The Sphere
apps.short_description: Corebreaker: The Sphere is an incremental bullet-hell mining game with rogue-lite mechanics. In this sci-fi fantasy shooter, you must survive the swarm while harvesting actual elements from the periodic table to upgrade your ship's arsenal.

apps.name: Countdown to Midnight
apps.short_description: It's New Year's Eve, and you don't plan to live to see midnight. But a strange girl crashes in from the sky and gives you one last lease on life. Explore the city, collect items, and talk to a variety of colorful characters as you learn what it means to live.

apps.name: COUNTERSUN
apps.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in 1953, the year a second sun rose. Build a base, mine ore, chop wood, drill for oil and command armies on land, sea and air against the Umbral. Two campaigns, ranked online, skirmish, LAN and a map editor.

apps.name: Crafty Idle
apps.short_description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

apps.name: Crash Pandas
apps.short_description: Hijack cars and race to the finish as chaotic raccoons in this physics-based party racer! Every vehicle is up for grabs as you battle for control, sabotage rivals, and dodge relentless authorities. Online or local multiplayer!

apps.name: Crashpad: Cozy Idle Outpost
apps.short_description: A cozy idle outpost that sits in a corner of your desktop and keeps running while you work. Your ship crash-landed on a floating rock and two little robots made it out. Build a base from the wreck, collect a fleet of little ships and send them into the fog.

apps.name: CRED
apps.short_description: CRED is a sci-fi story-based narrative game with operating-system simulation features and a worldview centered around an ananomaly-management organization. Players will experience a series of events and make fateful choices as they learn more about the organization and the universe it is in.

apps.name: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
apps.short_description: Embark on a colorful adventure set in a nighttime environment in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures and demons with eight attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim Realms, and overcome perilous demons, creatures, and obstacles to complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

apps.name: Crop Guardian
apps.short_description: Crop Guardian is a cozy game that blends farming with dungeon adventure. Explore, fight monsters, discover seeds and tools, and strengthen your farm to survive nightly attacks. Farm by day. Fight to protect your harvest by night.

apps.name: Crossroad Chaos
apps.short_description: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.

apps.name: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
apps.short_description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

apps.name: CTRL+ALT+BURN
apps.short_description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

apps.name: Cup Wars
apps.short_description: A 1v1 fighting game where cups throw down on kitchen counters. Your cup is your fighter and your drink is your health AND your special-move fuel, so every splash costs you. Block, counter and combo through 10 cups, 10 drinks and 11 hand-painted arenas, at home or online.

apps.name: Damashi Game
apps.short_description: A thrilling multiplayer experience where social deception, strategy, and quick thinking are your greatest weapons. Outsmart your opponents and be the last player standing in this intense fight for survival.

apps.name: DAN DAN THE TIER LIST TOGETHER!
apps.short_description: A co-op party game for up to 111 players. Only the host buys it; everyone else joins from a phone browser with a room code. One player gets a secret rank, the group guesses it, and one tier list grows.

apps.name: DancingMouse: Origin
apps.short_description: Watch your cursor dance a creature into existence, line by line. Something in this place has been waiting. It will teach you everything you need to know.

apps.name: Das Verlies
apps.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

apps.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
apps.short_description: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

apps.name: DOOM 3: Phobos
apps.short_description: Waking up on Mars with no memory and a wound you can’t explain, you begin a desperate search for answers - about yourself, your past, and the catastrophe looming over two worlds.

apps.name: Drachenquell
apps.short_description:
Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt.
Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

apps.name: Drones vs Tanks
apps.short_description: Multiplayer Clash of Tanks and FPV Drones. Dive into a thrilling multiplayer showdown where one player controls a tank aiming to reach its destination, while the other pilots an FPV drone tasked with stopping it. Choose your faction, upgrade your vehicles, and compete in fast-paced rounds!

apps.name: Dungeon Janitor
apps.short_description: Clean up the messy dungeon, collect and recycle resources and find forgotten loot in this active incremental “chore-like”. Dispose of dead bodies, broken artillery and left-over treasure, wipe the bloody floors and slay the remaining monsters to ready the dungeon for its next great battle.

apps.name: Dungeon Nox Exotica
apps.short_description: A retro first-person dungeon RPG with manual exploration, automatic return routes, and battles you can automate or command. Loot, regroup, read your expedition logs, and descend one floor deeper.

apps.name: DungeonBox
apps.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

apps.name: Edgefield
apps.short_description: Edgefield is a mix of the adult visual novel, dating sim and point-and-click adventure genres with a wide and colorful cast of characters to meet, befriend, and romance (in fully animated scenes) as you make your way through your freshman year at Edgefield University.

apps.name: Eight Legs, Seven Nights
apps.short_description: Aunt Margit hasn't read your messages in nine days. At her house, a note asks you to look after her thirteen spiders for a week. You are terrified of spiders. Then the snow closes the roads. Feed them, mist them, keep them alive, and get through seven nights in a house that isn't empty.

apps.name: Eldkin
apps.short_description: Cosy creature-collecting in a living pixel world. Bond with and evolve over 130 kin, battle side by side in real time and ride them through sky, sea and lava. Flood caves, burn forests and blast tunnels with your kin, alone or with up to three friends, and face six titans to restore the sun.

apps.name: ELEVEN RISING
apps.short_description: They said you'd be gone by Christmas. Become a football manager: choose your squad, set roles and tactics, plan training and find players in the transfer market. Follow live matches, pause to adjust tactics and substitutions, and build your career alongside the people at your club.

apps.name: Elfscape: Ancestors
apps.short_description: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.

apps.name: Elk, Grove's Last Guard
apps.short_description: Defend the sacred grove against an endless wave of living shadows. Fight the horde with a horde of your own creation, wield strange powers, and survive increasingly chaotic battles from every direction.

apps.name: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point
apps.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

apps.name: Evacuation
apps.short_description: Evacuation is an unofficial story-driven add-on for Half-life 2, telling the story of an rebel who crashes on a helicopter in the woods. Having miraculously survived, the hero picks up a walkie-talkie and decides to escape from the forest, which was attacked by the Combine.

apps.name: Evil Remnant
apps.short_description: Your new life begins with the perfect job offer—until your daughter mysteriously disappears. In Evil Remnanat, a first-person horror experience, uncover the secrets of a dark house, solve puzzles, and discover the truth behind that terrifying night.

apps.name: Ewetopia
apps.short_description: A simple desktop companion game where sheep eat grass and develop personalities while you work. Connect to your friends, place new activities, and watch your sheep experience what it’s like to be alive.

apps.name: Exodus Directive
apps.short_description: Earth is lost. You are the Ferryman of the Last. Guide a generation ship through the dark: from a single terminal you command power, air, water and food, and keep the last humans alive. A bleak survival sim about responsibility, loss and hope.

apps.name: Exposed Livestream: Gamble
apps.short_description: Overcome your fears and become a live streamer in this RPG adventure game! Play as Honomi, a shy girl who needs to earn 1 million yen. Stream in public, fulfill viewer challenges, push your limits, and discover how far you'll go for bigger payouts. Show your viewers what they really want to see!

apps.name: Farwoods
apps.short_description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

apps.name: Femboy Futa Cruise
apps.short_description: One ocean liner. €4.2 million in debt. Fourteen nights to save her. Inherit the Pink Pearl, romance a cast of femboys and futas, follow a trail of hidden pearls, and uncover sabotage in an adult visual novel filled with Mediterranean romance, mystery, and minigames.

apps.name: FerroFrame
apps.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy  ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

apps.name: Fibonex
apps.short_description: Turn numbers into firepower. Build conveyor lines, calculate the ammunition your towers need and defend your Core in this single-player factory and tower-defense game. Reach the first boss, keep going in Endless, or experiment in Sandbox with or without enemies.

apps.name: Final Tactics
apps.short_description: This is a f2p online tactical turn based strategy 1v1 grid-based pvp game (with pve) and infinite replayability; you can play this the rest of your life. There are 140+ BALANCED units with move/attack and 4 abilities, & i'll always be adding more. Use your entire army every turn. No P2W, pure skill.

apps.name: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures
apps.short_description: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!

apps.name: Flame Cycle
apps.short_description: FlameCycle is a brutal, ultra-minimalist open-world soulslike. Start at the bottom of the food chain, build an infinite deck of combat abilities, and adapt as the world radically metamorphoses with every single death.

apps.name: Flaunt
apps.short_description: Pour, stir, shake and layer real liquids in a 2D fluid simulation. Serve more than 100 classic cocktails, beers and mocktails to impatient guests, keep your bar spotless, pay the rent and win over the hidden critics whose awards make your bar famous.

apps.name: FLICK: Knockout
apps.short_description: Every flick counts in FLICK: Knockout, a physics-driven competitive arena game. Aim your shot, knock rivals out, and turn precise hits into big plays. Build your puck lineup, master the angles, and switch things up in BOB mode. Small move. Big consequences.

apps.name: Flowers to Honey
apps.short_description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

apps.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
apps.short_description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

apps.name: Fox7: City Of Fighters
apps.short_description: Explore 10 cities, build your fighter through boxing, kickboxing, wrestling and MMA, then battle using strategic cards, submissions and whatever the street puts within reach. Rise from bar fights and underground pits to become king of the cage.

apps.name: Fractal Forge: Sierpinski's Sanctuary
apps.short_description: An incremental idler about recursively creating several famous fractals, managing your workers, and balancing multiple production lines to prevail against the exponential growth inherent in the mathematics of fractals.

apps.name: FrontierCraft
apps.short_description: FrontierCraft is a massively multiplayer sandbox set on one vast, fully destructible planet. Twenty kingdoms, thousands of ruins, and every player in the same world. Mine, build, trade and fight. Help kingdoms rise or fall, raise your clan's banner and carve out your place on the frontier.

apps.name: Frontlines: World in Conflict
apps.short_description: Command armies across a detailed 3D war table. Capture territories, secure bonus regions and outplan rival commanders in six-player online battles, solo skirmishes and guided training. Choose your rules, customise your commander and conquer the world.

apps.name: Frostliner
apps.short_description: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

apps.name: Fruit Kombat
apps.short_description: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.

apps.name: Furthia Trails
apps.short_description: Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. After a cliffside tumble, he finds himself lost in the mysterious Goomshi Forest - a wild and dangerous place full of strange, alluring creatures with their own instincts.

apps.name: Fuwamee: Sheep’s New Year! - Out Now
apps.short_description: 2027 is the Year of the Sheep! Float a woolly sheep up to the New Year's dawn, count sheep to the beat, herd your flock home before midnight, and more. Nine bite-sized sheep minigames, each playable in minutes - some with a friend, versus or co-op - plus high scores and leaderboards to chase.

apps.name: Galanost
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op village game for 1 to 8 players. Welcome new neighbors, build your village together and fill the tavern at night. Meet the island's wildlife and live through every season. At the bottom of the old mine, a sealed door waits.

apps.name: Gang
apps.short_description: Five rival gangs. One city. One turf war waiting to explode. Shoot your way through ever-changing streets with an arsenal of ridiculous weapons. Blast enemies with bread, fire books like cannonballs, and send rival bosses to their knees. It's a dog-eat-dog world. Good thing your boss is a cat.

apps.name: Gay Cape Diaries
apps.short_description: Deon just landed a job at a high-powered law firm. There’s one problem: he looks exactly like someone else who works there. A steamy, funny gay romance visual novel about mistaken identity, office secrets, and finally letting go.

apps.name: GeneJinks: Sports Festival
apps.short_description: Breed unusual creatures, build skill loadouts and take direct control in seven sports events, from arena clashes to forest races. Play solo or host an online game so friends can join over the internet and compete together.

apps.name: Genigods: Nezha
apps.short_description: Genigods: Nezha is an ARPG rooted in the chaos of ancient Chinese creation mythology. Play as Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

apps.name: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
apps.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

apps.name: Goblins Gotta Go
