apps.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

apps.name: Godborne: Ashes of Ramessu
apps.short_description: A first‑person tower defense hybrid where you summon towers that fight off waves of enemies while you solve the puzzles of the ancient ruins around you.

apps.name: Gold Admiral
apps.short_description: Explore, trade, research, and fight across a turn-based naval strategy sandbox. Found coastal cities, command fleets and armies, clear pirate hideouts and dungeons, and shape each campaign through economy, diplomacy, or conquest.

apps.name: Grand Bonk
apps.short_description: Your crew vs. every cop in town. Grand Bonk is a 4-player co-op horde survival roguelite: hold your block against an entire police department, level up a build that's all yours, stack it until it breaks, and bonk every wave that dares show up.

apps.name: Grandpa Loves Trains
apps.short_description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

apps.name: Grape Stomper
apps.short_description: Stomp grapes barefoot! A first-person incremental game inspired by traditional winemaking. Crush grapes, sell wine, and buy upgrades to automate your winery. Go from barefoot stomping to rows of busy machines, earning more each day. Secrets await deep in the cellar.

apps.name: Grave Profits
apps.short_description: Auto-battler Dungeoncrawler without PvP in a Dark Fantasy setting. Recruit, Match 3 to level up, build game breaking synergies with items and unlocks. Supports 2 player online CO-OP

apps.name: Greed Grind Golden
apps.short_description:
A deck‑building roguelike where you grow your deck little by little by returning from your adventure.
Bring back the cards you’ve collected and strengthen your deck at your own pace.

apps.name: GRIDDLE 66
apps.short_description: GRIDDLE 66 is a hands-on fast-food job simulator. Grill burgers, prepare fries and drinks, serve customers, and clean up after each shift. Work solo or in 2-player online co-op, sharpen your skills, and rise from part-timer to the Hall of Fame.

apps.name: Happily Never After
apps.short_description: Happily Never After is a low-poly retro adventure with psychological horror elements set in a surreal, distorted Lebanon. Drive through eerie streets, solve unsettling puzzles, and survive everyday absurdities turned nightmarish as you uncover the dark secrets of a corrupted reality.

apps.name: Harper and Lyre
apps.short_description: Jump into Harper and Lyre's adventure! Control a red panda and otter duo through classic 3D platforming action. Jump, collect, explore colorful worlds, unlock transformations, solve puzzles, and battle enemies in this nostalgic adventure inspired by beloved N64 classics.

apps.name: Haunted Echoes
apps.short_description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

apps.name: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
apps.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

apps.name: Hell Hell
apps.short_description: Hell Hell is a cooperative action stealth game that combines "tag" and "hide-and-seek. Players must work together to collect items in the stage as ordered, summon gates and escape from prison within a time limit, while hiding or running away to avoid detection by the demon that roam the stage.

apps.name: Heroes of the Forgotten Land
apps.short_description: A Norse fantasy tower defense. Build and upgrade five tower types, lead heroes into battle, forge runes and rebuild your village as you push back the darkness across forest, frost and fire. Twelve chapters, three game modes.

apps.name: Hey, Izumi, Watch This!
apps.short_description: It is a visual novel game about two women. The protagonist, who is a university student, goes for a walk late at night. An unknown woman points a gun at the protagonist and asks her whether she will follow her or not. After following her, they decide to live outdoors together for a while, but...

apps.name: Hikki Life
apps.short_description: A story-driven action-adventure about a shut-in who flees people into video games. A talking cat leads him to a parallel world, where he fights in a dungeon, grows stronger, seeks his missing grandfather, and regains his memories. But the further he goes, the less that world looks like the truth.

apps.name: HITLER BACKROOMS
apps.short_description: HITLER BACKROOMS is a co-op game for 1-6 players, where you must make your way through the Backrooms while avoiding the Hitler entity. Explore the Backrooms alone, or with friends! Progress through the levels and try to survive. Will you find the way out? Or will another hidden world await?

apps.name: Hockey Coach Dynasty
apps.short_description: Coach your way from high-school and AAA 18U benches to the top of world hockey. Run the lines, the systems, the training and the room; answer the board; take the job that calls. A text-first career sim across 140 leagues and 2,109 clubs — and every name is yours to edit.

apps.name: Hollow Galley
apps.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel goes silent above a hydrothermal vent field, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this hand-drawn, anime cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery.

apps.name: Home Before Dusk
apps.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

apps.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
apps.short_description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

apps.name: HONKSHOT
apps.short_description: HONKSHOT is a fast-paced arcade car-combat game where you drift, jump, and blast your way to ten eliminations in four-car Deathmatch! Play online with friends, practice solo against bots, or take on 20-car Weapon Race and Junkyard Royale.

apps.name: Hordebound
apps.short_description: A 3D co-op survivor roguelike for 1 to 4 players. Pick a champion, run and slide through a horde of hundreds, stack auto-firing weapons into absurd builds, beat the boss and get out alive. Seven biomes, 29 champions, and a horde to destory.

apps.name: Horror Simulator
apps.short_description: A night shift at the precinct turns into a nightmare when the terrifying "Subject #4" breaks free from the basement. No weapons, locked doors, dead comms. Navigate a maze of hallways, crack safes, and hide in the dark. Your shift lasts until 08:00. Will you live to see the dawn?

apps.name: House of Wardians: Unchained
apps.short_description: Recruit, customize and evolve your Wardians, then send them into fast automatic battles where strategy is decided before the fight. Combine species, classes, weapons, skills and guardian spirits into your perfect build, and climb seasonal leagues against other players' Wardians.

apps.name: HoverShot
apps.short_description: Shooting is the only way to move. Master zero-gravity combat where every shot is both movement and attack. Experiment with weapons and stackable items that change how you fight and move. Unlock new characters and abilities as you battle through each roguelite run.

apps.name: Hunter Road
apps.short_description:
Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters?
Buy rifles at the shop?
Defeated allies vanish forever?
Welcome to the new standard of permadeath 2D monster-hunting RPGs.
Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

apps.name: I Am Cat: Vacation
apps.short_description: Your favorite cat is going on vacation! Explore sunny beaches, swim with colorful fish, build sandcastles, dig for hidden treasures, and enjoy fun mini-games. Join Granny and her grandson for a brand-new sandbox adventure full of surprises and cat chaos!

apps.name: I'd Choose the Bear
apps.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

apps.name: Idle Camp Tale
apps.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

apps.name: Idle Cultivator: Ascend Together
apps.short_description: Idle Cultivator is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a world of Chinese fantasy. Auto-battle beasts and bosses, collect and upgrade gear, and grow stronger. Adventure solo or team up online with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

apps.name: Idle Harmony
apps.short_description:
An idle game where you build compositions to earn money. Unlock notes, chords, instruments & effects then evolve your melody. 
Experiment and make the next big hit, export & share it anywhere!

apps.name: Idle Primes
apps.short_description: A cursed incremental horror game with PSX-style graphics. Find a strange CD-ROM, boot it on your bedroom computer, and click prime numbers to buy upgrades and automate the search, while something on the other side of the screen takes an interest in you. ████████████████████ Belphegor's ██████!

apps.name: IJIN: History Survivors
apps.short_description: Who's the strongest in history? Become Napoleon, Musashi, or Cleopatra and mow down huge hordes in survivors-style action. Just move — attacks are automatic. Evolve each legend's weapon into their myth. Ice at Austerlitz, fog at Sekigahara rewrite the battlefield. 4-player online/local co-op.

apps.name: INKURSION
apps.short_description: You’re a newly super-sentient octopus trapped inside a game, and your unhinged creator watches your every move. Escape his abandoned worlds, question the characters left behind, and uncover the hidden truth across 8 endings.

apps.name: Inside Job
apps.short_description: Escape prison in co-op with 1–4 players – or survive LAST COUNT with up to 10: no teams, deadly games, only one walks out. Work the inmates, trade, gamble, and pick your moment.

apps.name: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories
apps.short_description: It's Always Grey is a detective mystery serial, inspired by real true crime cases. In a city of perpetual rain, Detective Molly Grey investigates a horrific discovery made years after the crime took place. Search for clues, highlight critical evidence, and connect the dots to find those responsible.

apps.name: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
apps.short_description: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

apps.name: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
apps.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

apps.name: K-God Robot Hunters
apps.short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

apps.name: Kaiju Crash
apps.short_description: A real-time action game playing as Kaiju on a fully destructible map with real-time physics and collision. As you level up, choose your upgrades from fire, lightning, acid, and others. Defend yourself, eat people, topple buildings, and watch them fall.  Make them pay!

apps.name: Keepguard
apps.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

apps.name: Kesselgrid
apps.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the Great War and in the Second World War. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

apps.name: Keystrike
apps.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

apps.name: Kid on Couch Quest
apps.short_description: Welcome to Kid On Couch Quest – an action-packed 2D platform shooter where adorable characters face dangerous monsters, powerful bosses, and tons of loot! Fight your way through hordes of monsters alone or with your friends, or challenge each other in thrilling arena battles!

apps.name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM
apps.short_description:
"The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..."

KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

apps.name: Kings & Savages
apps.short_description:
A fast-paced, high skill Solo/Auto-Battler.

Easy to learn, hard to master. 

Inspired by Chess and Dota.

apps.name: Kings Trader
apps.short_description: King's Trader is a medieval trading tycoon with a combo system. Buy low, sell high, and stack combos to multiply your profit. Pay the king's tax, unlock new markets, and build the perfect basket.

apps.name: Kursk Kiosk
apps.short_description: A trading roguelike set in a kiosk in provincial Russia, 2004. Fill a 20-slot board with products, discover profitable combinations, buy upgrades, and meet your sales quotas. Occasionally, the locals will stop by to talk. Fortunately, you can turn that off.

apps.name: Land of Manifestations: Sanctuary
apps.short_description: A fantasy RPG blending romance, roguelite shooting, and city building. Awakening in the Tianwen Temple with no memory of the past, you discover that an unknown force is corrupting the Land of Manifestations, twisting Xiangling into monsters. To save the world, you must build a Sanctuary.

apps.name: Lavender's
apps.short_description: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

apps.name: Leaf to Sun
apps.short_description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

apps.name: Life of a caveman
apps.short_description:
Live the colorful life of a caveman. 
Eat and interact with other cavemen in order to grow stronger and smarter. 
Once you are strong enough, become the leader of your group and guide them to safety; 
safety from things like the the beast that attacks at night and the other tribe that left tracks in your area.

apps.name: Light From Within
apps.short_description: Light From Within is a top-down action-adventure focused on exploration, dungeon crawling, and discovery. Traverse a handcrafted world, solve puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and collect relics that expand your abilities, boost your stats, and alter how you interact with the environment.

apps.name: Lingering Shadow
apps.short_description: Lingering Shadow is a psychological horror puzzle game set in a 2000s small town. On her birthday, Lanlan returns home to find her father missing. To find him, she must navigate eerie streets and piece together nostalgic yet unsettling memories to uncover a dark truth.

apps.name: LINGORIA
apps.short_description: 在七款游戏里练外语。在 Idle 战斗中培养你的学生，白天顺手答几张学习卡片；也可以换成赛车、生存、边境检查、公会经营、听写和拼句集市。界面为简体中文，可以学英语、西班牙语、德语、波兰语、俄语和葡萄牙语，学过的单词会通过间隔重复再回来。

apps.name: Little Backpack
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art puzzle game about organizing items inside your backpack. There are 48 handcrafted levels made to be relaxing and satisfying to play.

apps.name: Lola's Familiars
apps.short_description: Escape a demonic underworld prison in this stunning anime inspired lite-vania adventure. Explore mysterious magical realms, forge pacts with powerful Familiar bosses, uncover dark secrets, and guide Lola through an emotional journey of growth in a haunting dark fantasy world.

apps.name: Looting Frogs
apps.short_description: A co-op heist game for up to 6 players. You're tiny frogs breaking into human houses: sneak past homeowners and pets, snatch loot with your grappling-hook tongues, and upgrade your hideout. Expect messy heists, frog-sized chaos, and zero trustworthy teammates.

apps.name: Lord of the Fleet: Idle
apps.short_description: The Galactic Empire is on the brink, and your fleet is its last hope. Fleet King: Idle is a relaxed, satisfying sci-fi idle game — build and grow your space fleet, explore deep space, crush powerful foes, and restore order and peace to the Empire.

apps.name: Ludus Magna
apps.short_description: Ludus Magna combines auto-battler combat, gladiator management, and strategic quick-time events in a dark, run-based strategy game set in ancient Rome. Lead your gladiator school as a Lanista, develop unique fighters, manage gold and risk, and keep your House from bankruptcy.

apps.name: Magic Castle: Tidy Up The Kingdom
apps.short_description: Wield a magic wand and rebuild a scattered fairy-tale castle piece by piece in this cozy first-person game. Charm stones into place, sweep away rubble, earn upgrades and restore five enchanted halls, alone or in online co-op with up to 4 mages.

apps.name: MAGICAL ANGEL PRINCESS LYNN
apps.short_description: Flashy action with the adorable Princess Lynn! Fight against the mysterious invaders threatening the city.

apps.name: Magus Slayer
apps.short_description: Every magus you break drops an eye, and the eye gives you its spell. One click fires all your stolen spells in the order you set, so a black hole cast before the swords makes them burst out of it in a ring. A gothic action roguelite with 40 spells to steal and 16 wings.

apps.name: Mall Chaos
apps.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

apps.name: Manabies
apps.short_description: Embark on an action adventure across floating islands where magical creatures, fast-paced arena battles, and an ever-growing flying base hide a unique twist: every battle is powered by real mathematics, helping you become smarter with every challenge.

apps.name: Maple and Aluna
apps.short_description: Fight together as Maple and Aluna in this action-adventure roguelike. Slaughter foes, capture altars, and augment yourself with powerful mystics to survive the eternal winter.

apps.name: Matter of State
apps.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

apps.name: MeloMisterio -play your melody-
apps.short_description: MeloMisterio is a music-driven 3D platformer where every action you take creates melodies. Use those melodies to control mechanics and reach the goal.

apps.name: Melted Valor: The Plastic Crusade
apps.short_description: The Green Army replaced them. Now the Tan want their plastic back. Fight through a brutal single-player third-person campaign as a desperate toy war erupts from the shelves into the human world. Every toy, insect and machine is dragged into the conflict.

apps.name: Memory Games Squirrels
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Mind’s Judgment
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. You wake in a hotel whose hallways repeat endlessly, never quite the same. Inspect every object, decipher its clues, and unravel its puzzles while something stalks you from the shadows. What you unearth will shape the verdict that awaits you.

apps.name: Mine Ore Else
apps.short_description: Little robots, lost in an ancient mine. Dig through solid rock for gold and gems, haul it home in your base's cart, and knock the ore out of your rivals' hands. Nobody gets hurt. Everybody gets robbed. Play solo against bots, or online with up to 32 players.

apps.name: MineralMarket
apps.short_description: Back a mineral discovery before the market catches on. Trade shares in a single-player stock market sim where companies explore, drill and publish results. Study the evidence, weigh the risk and decide whether to buy, hold or get out. Could you be the one to make it big?

apps.name: Minimalist Industry Tycoon
apps.short_description: Minimalist Farm Tycoon is a resource management game. Grow crops, raise livestock, research upgrades, build factories and produce goods. Turn a failing farm into a profitable business.

apps.name: Mondrayn
apps.short_description: Mondrayn is a grim JRPG with survival elements where dying doesn't mean the end of your suffering. Dig into the remnants of a dead world, exterminate monsters, craft your gear. Help yourself and other restless souls make their way to Anthrum.

apps.name: MONOMANIA
apps.short_description: Obsessive 3D games in one package. Journey through a world of magic, keep insects that move like the real thing, catch and evolve monsters, build robots from gacha parts, and let a bullied boy's rage explode. One game. Many worlds. More arriving in Early Access.

apps.name: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
apps.short_description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

apps.name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
apps.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

apps.name: Mount Tartarus
apps.short_description: Survive the underworld in Mount Tartarus, a bullet heaven roguelite. Cut through endless monster hordes and combine skills and passives into devastating builds. Every run earns gold for permanent upgrades, so each death makes you stronger. Besides, where else would you go? You are already dead.

apps.name: Mr Police
apps.short_description: Patrol the streets, search suspicious trunks and put troublemakers behind bars in this first-person comedy police sim. Chase suspects, investigate crime scenes and hand out fines. Even Grandma isn't above the law. Your donut break will have to wait.

apps.name: Multiverse Survivors
apps.short_description: Unlock every universe, then field heroes and skills from different worlds together — dream matchups no history would allow. Einstein raises havoc in the Heavenly Court. Ancient generals hand-build an atom bomb. Odin opens fire with a gun. Sun Wukong fights aliens, and more.

apps.name: Murder in the Arctic Circle
apps.short_description: Murder in the Arctic Circle is a point-and-click exploration, photography and mystery adventure game in which the backgrounds are actual photos of real Norway - they were shot on location.

apps.name: My Beautiful Aquarium
apps.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

apps.name: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
apps.short_description:
One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city...

Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

apps.name: My Little Dino Den
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art desktop companion. Hatch eggs, name your baby dinos and raise them in a little den on your screen while you work. Feed, pet and tuck them in, then send them into turn-based battles, solo or as a pack of three, to unlock new species and face the dragons.

apps.name: My Time at Evershine
apps.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

apps.name: Naked Pursuit
apps.short_description: Naked Pursuit is an adults-only tropical chase game inspired by reality television. Track, capture, and outsmart unique contestants while climbing the leaderboard in a fast-paced island competition.

apps.name: NEET
apps.short_description: Alone on Halloween? How pathetic. Learn and choose how to live your sorry life, talk to a series of surreal visitors and witness the unspeakable in this highly interactive, soulful and atmospheric life simulator.

apps.name: Netherborn
apps.short_description: Become the embodiment of demonic fury in Netherborn, a fast-paced roguelite where you play as Lucius,the son of the Devil himself. Rip through hordes of twisted Furia creatures,unleash and evolve hellish abilities and carve your way through an endless onslaught in a world that refuses to let you go.

apps.name: Ninth Hell
apps.short_description: Humanity is dying. The answers lie centuries in the past. In this dark fantasy action RPG, hunt the source of corruption across six eras. Shape and master your build, discover rare loot and follow the trail beyond Heaven’s gates into the nine depths of Hell. Uncover what humanity tried to bury.

apps.name: No Shot
apps.short_description: Launch into a zero-gravity arena and execute with your team in a fast-paced and intense sport only possible in virtual reality.

apps.name: NodeFeat
apps.short_description: Still reading? The black tide is back. No bones, no end. You don't build a base: you grow one, a mutant tree of concrete and steel, hungry for death. Order its branches, rewrite the ground, grind them to paste. There is no future. There is the wall.

apps.name: Nostos
apps.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

apps.name: Now You're Cooking
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

apps.name: NS Drive Simulator
apps.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

apps.name: Oddinary Farm
apps.short_description: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a bizarre island filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

apps.name: OKTORAID
apps.short_description: Survive the AI robot uprising, solo or with a friend on one couch. Scavenge scrap, build a turret fortress, then auto-blast endless hordes in a roguelite siege, while the live power cable that ties you together fries every robot that crosses it.

apps.name: On The Hook
apps.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

apps.name: One More Jackpot!
apps.short_description: Your arcade is dying. Nobody comes in. So you play every machine yourself. An active arcade incremental: smash, upgrade, wire it up, hit the JACKPOT!

apps.name: One More Wave: Tower Defense
apps.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

apps.name: Order of the Jarl
apps.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

apps.name: Our campus life
apps.short_description:
Our campus life is an AVG set against the backdrop of modern university life.
In an alternate contemporary world, players step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience a story where sports, friendship, and even romance intertwine with multiple characters.

apps.name: Out of the Park Baseball 22
apps.short_description: Play What The Pros Play! Officially licensed by MLB, MiLB, and the MLBPA, Out of the Park Baseball 22 is the newest in the award-winning strategy series. Fun, authenticity, and depth make it a sports fan’s dream come true - and the only game ever to win Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award TWICE.

apps.name: PaleBlueRose
apps.short_description: Pale Blue Rose is a free-to-play online medieval city builder with real-time war. Grow a town from a founding wagon, master production chains, trade with up to 10,000 players and conquer rivals on one seamless world. Win by reaching 90% of the world's yearly economy.

apps.name: Pay to Think
apps.short_description:
An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset.

Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence;

now, intelligence has found a new master.

Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

apps.name: Pencil Shavings Soup
apps.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

apps.name: PET HUMAN
apps.short_description: Your livestock have human faces. Your customers have animal heads. Run a cursed farm, fulfil unsettling orders, and keep $300 by 5 AM. Buy weapons from a sinister merchant and uncover what waits beneath the farm in this first-person horror game.

apps.name: Phylactery Slayer
apps.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

apps.name: Pinetrail
apps.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

apps.name: Pixel Imperium
apps.short_description: Create a world, watch it live. Or take matters into your own hands. Generate, draw, or import a real map, on land or among the stars. Customize it, painting its resources, realms, and peoples. Then watch history unfold, guide it in god mode, or lead a faction to glory yourself.

apps.name: Poli City
apps.short_description: Build a beautiful town, run its economy and services, win its votes and stay in power. Every train line, tax and law moves your voters, and they decide whether you keep the keys to Town Hall, or whether you refuse to hand them back.

apps.name: Pool of Madness
apps.short_description:
A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals.
Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

apps.name: Portal Reloaded
apps.short_description: Portal Reloaded is a free, community made modification for Portal 2. The mod builds on the concepts of the main game by allowing you to place a third portal, which enables traveling between two different timelines. Thinking in four dimensions is vital to solving 25 brand new mind-bending puzzles.

apps.name: Portal: System Failure
apps.short_description: Portal: System Failure is an upcoming fan-made mod that expands upon the Portal universe with all-new puzzles and a darker narrative, all to deliver an epic singleplayer campaign. This new, full-length campaign will feature a carefully crafted story with new characters, and a unique soundtrack.

apps.name: Power Washing: Bear Cemetery
apps.short_description: Take over the care of Bear Hollow’s overgrown cemetery. Wash weathered headstones, mow the grass, and bring a little peace to its residents. Your predecessor left you the tools for the job—but looking after this place means more than keeping it tidy.

apps.name: Project Stampede
apps.short_description: Project Stampede is a fast-paced arcade racer where aggression is progression. Choose a vehicle, from dirt bikes to monster trucks, and rip it up around the globe in the most insane off-road racing league on earth. Race, wreck, and battle your way to become the top driver in the Stampede Festival!

apps.name: Psychose
apps.short_description:
Try the new experience Psychose horror game.
Sneak around to complete puzzles without getting caught, paid attention to the noises, to the lights.

apps.name: Pteranodon 2: Primal Island
apps.short_description: A first-person adventure packed with intense spear-throwing combat, ferocious dinosaurs, and thrilling pirate action! Arm yourself with a musketoon, hurl molotovs, and navigate a lush prehistoric world teeming with danger. Gameplay Time: 3-7 hours

apps.name: Pull Over!
apps.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

apps.name: Radar Shadow
apps.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

apps.name: Ragdoll Ranch
apps.short_description: Raise chickens, rabbits, pigs, and cows on the most chaotic ranch you’ve ever seen. Expand your operation solo or bring a friend in this challenging FPS farming simulator.

apps.name: Ramen Shop in the Floating Slums
apps.short_description: Start penniless in a floating slum. Scavenge for supplies, choose from dozens of ingredients to create your own ramen, and grow your shop in this first-person ramen shop and life sim. Earn money and build your reputation, go fishing, and explore a city created just for this game.

apps.name: Ramen://protocol
apps.short_description:
🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.
Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills.
Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying.
Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

apps.name: Rat Hunt
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game: a swarm of tiny rats must outlast hungry hawks in a giant backyard. The twist? Moving gives you away, so freeze to vanish in the grass. Whisper to friends with proximity voice... if you dare. Get caught and you JOIN the hunt.

apps.name: Ravenfield: Multiplayer Mod
apps.short_description: That's right folks! Ravenfield now has its very own community-curated multiplayer mode! RFMP is a community project with the sole goal of bringing multiplayer to Ravenfield. You can now join in the multiplayer PvP mayhem with your Eagle (or Raven) Allies to eliminate those pesky Ravens (or Eagles)!

apps.name: Raze The Realm
apps.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

apps.name: Rebel Roar
apps.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

apps.name: Red Eye Empire
apps.short_description: Build a global airline from a single prop-plane. Your planes fly real routes on a living globe and keep earning while you're away. Grow hubs, unlock new regions, then sell your airline and start a holding company of subsidiaries. A relaxing idle tycoon that lives on your desktop.

apps.name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
apps.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

apps.name: Reel Bad Fishing
apps.short_description: A washed-up fisherman, a debt to a mermaid, and an island chain full of gangs, gamblers and sea monsters. Fish with traps, sonar and a revolver, scratch off tickets for legendary catches, and shoot, scheme and gamble your way to the top of the worst sea in the world.

apps.name: Resources Assemble!
apps.short_description: Build, automate, and expand your factory. Mine resources, craft components, and evolve your systems toward full autonomy and interplanetary production

apps.name: Rest Stop
apps.short_description: Alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

apps.name: Retro Party
apps.short_description: Nostalgia for '90s games: 25+ mini-games in a single party. Play online with up to 8 people, or 4 on the same screen. Every game is its own kind of chaos: racing, shooting, a battle of wills, and plenty more. A chance to relive the good old days with your friends.

apps.name: Revenge Crystal Project
apps.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

apps.name: RIGGED2EXPLODE
apps.short_description: A tactical shooter where running out of bullets sets off a bomb strapped to your chest. Sneak through levels, take out enemies, and use the environment to your gain the advantage. Take your time and make every bullet count.

apps.name: ROBOSCAV
apps.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

apps.name: RockIt Ronnie
apps.short_description: Strap on a rocket pack and deliver the ridiculous. Thrust, coast and dodge through lively harbors, sandstone canyons, chaotic factories and neon festivals. Keep your cargo intact, chain risky pickups, upgrade your gear and earn delivery challenge stamps.

apps.name: Rotten Keep
apps.short_description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

apps.name: Round Table Rivals
apps.short_description: Round Table Rivals is a turn-based fighting game where your strategy starts the combo — but your timing keeps it alive. Build your team, chain attacks, take down powerful bosses, and challenge your friends in head-to-head battles.

apps.name: RSP Ultimate Battle
apps.short_description: Rock-paper-scissors meets strategic card autobattling! Collect and merge cards, build your team, and outsmart opponents through positioning, elemental matchups, unique abilities, and spells.

apps.name: Rúnafall
apps.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Safe at Dawn
apps.short_description: Supernatural events are taking place throughout the night. Keep a close watch on all the rooms and don't overlook even the smallest detail. Try to make it through the night, either alone, with the help of other players, or by competing against them. Will you be safe at dawn?

apps.name: Sanity Shooter
apps.short_description: A surreal boomer shooter where you fight through bizarre dimensions, master fast-paced combat, and adapt your tactics to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

apps.name: Save The Cat!
apps.short_description: A lost cat is waiting for you. Use your hand to shift the world, clear a path, and bring it home through 6 themed worlds and 120 handcrafted sliding puzzles. Avoid dogs, use boxes and portals, and keep your promise: this time, you will save the cat.

apps.name: Screenbreak
apps.short_description: Screenbreak is an action roguelike RPG set inside a corrupted computer system overrun by a dangerous virus. Fight through glitching programs, broken files, infected security systems, and unstable digital worlds as you uncover the truth behind the infection.

apps.name: Seven Nights at the Equator
apps.short_description: An adult romantic visual novel set during seven days in Singapore. Reconnect with old friends, make meaningful choices, build relationships, and explore four romantic routes. Your decisions shape the story and lead to one of 18 unique endings.

apps.name: Shadow Rush
apps.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

apps.name: SHAKE ME ALICE!
apps.short_description: Grab your phone and swing your arm! In this online co-op action game for 1–4 players inspired by Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Alice and her friends must work together to escape after angering the Queen of Hearts. Run, jump and throw your way through a madcap adventure!

apps.name: Shattered Dice of Fate
apps.short_description: Hold, reroll, and choose the hand that matters now. Grow from a Pioneer into your own class build across ten expeditions in this turn-based roguelite. Read enemy intent, time your skills, and turn the lessons of defeat into your next attempt.

apps.name: SHATTERFARMS
apps.short_description:
Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable.
Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

apps.name: Shipping Away
apps.short_description: Drowning in student debt, you take a job at your local post office. Customers hand you items to pack and envelopes to ship, while every shift brings new rules and a clock that never stops ticking. Pack boxes, beat the line, and wipe out your student debt in this time management job sim.

apps.name: Shire Scopes
apps.short_description: A multiplayer arena shooter with sniper-muskets, swords, and fluid movement mechanics. Climb the leaderboards!

apps.name: Siege Protocol
apps.short_description: Siege Protocol is a multiplayer first-person melee combat game where robots clash in team-based battles and competitive game modes. Fight with melee weapons and abilities, take control of objectives, and customize your robot.

apps.name: Singularity Rising
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn 2D physics-destruction shooter set in the first hours of an AI uprising. You are an old lighthouse keeper with a shotgun. Enemies are mechanisms, not health bars: every leg, brace and armour plate you break changes how the machine fights.

apps.name: Sit or Die
apps.short_description:
Music plays, chairs appear. Lie, cooperate, deceive. 
In a closed cylinder, up to 12 players face unpredictable survival rounds. Find a chair or be eliminated. It's more than a chair—it involves rules, order, perception, and lies. Who will you trust, and who is deceiving you?

apps.name: Slice Overdrive
apps.short_description: Slice Overdrive is a precision platformer built on speed, control, and flawless execution. Carve through deadly player-built levels, claim leaderboard glory, and ride the retro-synth soundtrack as you chase that perfect run.

apps.name: Slutopia
apps.short_description: Slutopia is a modern utopia centered around a luxurious dream villa! The most beautiful and liberated girls are waiting for you: an office siren, a sexy nurse, and other hot employees. Build your own debauched mansion and form the tightest relationships with your subordinates!

apps.name: Snake Echos
apps.short_description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

apps.name: Snake With Bird
apps.short_description: This project has currently ceased development. If we restart the project later, we will notify everyone on the Steam page and social media accounts.

apps.name: Solaro
apps.short_description: Explore space like an alien. Solaro is an experimental adventure game where you guide a tiny traveller through a vast galaxy of puzzles and trials.

apps.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
apps.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

apps.name: Souq Boss Simulator
apps.short_description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

apps.name: Spektr
apps.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

apps.name: Starbreaker
apps.short_description: Prospect a procedurally generated, infinite galaxy in this open-world space mining and combat sandbox. Carve ore from fully voxel based asteroids, outfit your ship, hunt bounties, and build your fortune! You can even bring a friend, or a few, in online (or LAN, up to you!) co-op/multiplayer!

apps.name: Stellar Overload
apps.short_description:
Robots invaded the peaceful planet Merx. Go on an adventure to free your world from them.

Stellar Overload is a 3D open-world, blocks-based, FPS, adventure game.

apps.name: STEP THEATER
apps.short_description:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) 
“STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

apps.name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
apps.short_description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

apps.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine
apps.short_description: Make yourself at home on the Maine coast. Explore an old captain's house, read by the window, fish from the dock, and look for sea glass along the tide line. Choose the season, weather, and time of day, or watch a storm come in off the Atlantic. A quiet place to return to at your own pace.

apps.name: StormEdge: Wind of Change
apps.short_description: Wind of Change is the first chapter of StormEdge, an action roguelite adventure. Dodge enemies' attacks, trigger deadly traps, and explore the captivating tale of Elemental Storms' origins. Brace for treacherous challenges and test your skills against the Tempests!

apps.name: Stormtide Skies
apps.short_description: Take command of a steam-powered airship and battle across the storm-torn skies. Fight solo, challenge AI, compete online, experience a cinematic story, or survive the relentless waves and colossal bosses of Redwake Siege.

apps.name: Strike Commander
apps.short_description: It's 2011, you command Stern’s Wildcats, an elite squadron of mercenaries trying to fly straight in a world of deceit and violence. Pilot advanced aircraft as you engage rival squadrons and the armies of the dreaded IRS.

apps.name: Suffer Together
apps.short_description: A 2-player online co-op comedy horror game. Describe symbols to your partner and defend yourself against deadly animatronics to win Stella’s game show!

apps.name: SUMOLYGONS
apps.short_description: Geometry with a grudge. A 1-4 player physics brawler where you win by shoving rivals out of the arena. No health bars. Just physics, skill & strategy. Pick a Shape with its own unique traits, combine abilities, discover their fusions, find your favorite combos, and build your own SUMOLYGON arenas!

apps.name: Sunny Trails
apps.short_description: Sunny Trails is a cozy turn-based RPG. Amaterasu and her sisters travel to a party on a paradisiacal Brazilian island, only to find all the guests turned to stone. Fish, decorate your camp, and explore the island to discover who petrified your friends!

apps.name: SUPER EXCITE BALL
apps.short_description: Smash incoming balls into your opponents' goals! A chaotic 1–4 player action game packed with special balls and wild arena gimmicks!

apps.name: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
apps.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

apps.name: Super Piotr Deluxe
apps.short_description: Jump from platform to platform, survive enemy waves and defeat bizarre bosses as Piotr descends through giant toilet portals into an ever-stranger arcade universe guided, questioned and occasionally mocked by Peypi, his living toiletpaper companion.

apps.name: SuperTrucks Multiplayer Racing
apps.short_description:
SuperTrucks is a competitive, real time, ranked multiplayer racing game. 
Race against real opponents on challenging track surfaces, upgrade your truck and rank up as you win races.

apps.name: Symloquy
apps.short_description: Meet Xuanxuan in Symloquy, a sound novel with AI dialogue. The Fading slowly erodes her memories and sense of self, while your conversations bring an Echo that helps her stay lucid. As you grow closer, discover her past and perhaps hear what she usually keeps to herself.

apps.name: SYNTAX WARS
apps.short_description: Both players pick a hidden move, then reveal at once — a duel of reads, not reflexes. Play solo: VS CPU, arcade, and challenge runs. Free demo (3 of 6 fighters). Strong, Weak, and Guard, plus signature moves and other actions. Play on the same screen, or online with Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Take One Down
apps.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

apps.name: Tempo Derby
apps.short_description: Tempo Derby is a timing-driven horse-racing roguelike. Hit the sweet spot, build powerful relic combinations and race through a 15-stage campaign. Unlock new horses, fuse legendary relics and outpace five bosses on your way to the championship.

apps.name: THE BACKLOG
apps.short_description: A used-game shop after closing, its floor buried under 5,000+ games and consoles. Pick one up, read the label, and put it on its console's shelf until the shop is tidy. A first-person tidying sim with no timer and no game over. Get faster, find small rewards, and play with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: The Black Below
apps.short_description: Classic grid-based dungeon crawling, rebuilt: a 3D dungeon reduced to stylized one-bit art, a score synthesized live, automapping, skill trees, and a party whose dead stay on the roster. Under a city that lives off a hole in the ground, something is sleeping, and nobody agrees on what it is.

apps.name: The Death Night Show
apps.short_description: The Death Night Show is a narrative game with multiple endings and unlockable scenes where you play as Death's intern in his own late night show. Control the audience's reactions to the events of the program, run errands, and uncover the overarching mystery with each new featured guest.

apps.name: The Deep Waits
apps.short_description: You have one minute to live. Eat, explore, fight, and craft your way off a cursed island before the deep takes you.

apps.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist
apps.short_description: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!

apps.name: The Fable of a Rabbit
apps.short_description: WIP

apps.name: The Fatal Card
apps.short_description: A tactical 1v1 card duel in a dark fantasy world. 31 characters with their own skills: curses, diseases, undead summons, attacks across the whole board. Place your cards, exploit your opponent's weaknesses and beat the AI or real players in ranked Steam matches.

apps.name: The Infinite Box
apps.short_description: A fully animated adult life-sim where you manage time, earn money, explore, and unlock animated character events through choices, schedules, and relationship progression.

apps.name: The Last Delivery
apps.short_description: Working the night shift at a remote roadside diner was supposed to just pay the bills. Instead, you're thrown into a web of strange patrons, unsolved disappearances, and a shadowy serial killer. Search the dark. Solve the past. Survive the shift.

apps.name: The Last Exterminator
apps.short_description: You're an exterminator. You kill things for a living. When a hostile invasion of alien cockroaches rocks your city, you've got a job to do. A high-octane retro-FPS inspired by some of the best games of the 90s.

apps.name: The Last Iron Sentinel
apps.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot. Mow through hordes of 100+ zombies, freeze time to draft upgrades, turn your bullets into fire, ice or lightning, and rip chainsaws and missile packs off elites to bolt onto yourself.

apps.name: The Little Cat Things
apps.short_description:
The Little Cat Things is a survival-themed role-playing game.
Players take on the role of a stray cat, forging friendships with all kinds of feline and canine companions as they struggle to survive in a forgotten corner of the city.

apps.name: The Little Cloud
apps.short_description: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

apps.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
apps.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

apps.name: The Old Parish
apps.short_description: A cozy top down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Clear and sow the family farm, raise cattle and sheep, fish the lake and cook Irish recipes. Chat with the neighbours after Sunday Mass and spend your evenings at O'Brien's over a pint and a hand of Twenty Five.

apps.name: The Singularity
apps.short_description: Face your friends in a futuristic/cyberpunk card game where each card unleashes a different kind of chaos. Manage to keep the Singularity in your hand until the end to be the winner. Establish the Singularity at the end of the game and disconnect your opponents. Are you ready?

apps.name: The Winner 2 - The Reality Show
apps.short_description: Experience what it's like to participate in a reality show in this casual, immersive, and fun simulator! Enter a medieval castle, compete for the title of ultimate winner, and enjoy a unique experience with an original soundtrack and fun 2D graphics.

apps.name: The Yield
apps.short_description: A minimalistic dystopian inspector simulator. Inspect packages, verify data, and log violations on your work sheet. Every mistake or delay brings you closer to a shift failure. Don't let the timer catch you off guard.

apps.name: Tidy Up: Street Market
apps.short_description: Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. Over 6,000 items are piled up around an open-air market: fruit, fish, shoes, flowers, toys and more. Carry each one to the right stall, earn money, buy upgrades, and turn a messy street into a full, colorful market.

apps.name: Tinsel Tumble
apps.short_description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Titan Hunters
apps.short_description: Grab your friends, load the cannons, and defend your castle from giant monsters in this chaotic 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Blast massive Titans apart piece by piece, upgrade your weapons, and try not to blow up your own base!

apps.name: Tithe
apps.short_description: Build a deathtrap arena. Raid someone else’s. Tithe is a dark-fantasy action raider where you design trap-filled gauntlets for other players to survive, then fight through theirs, and through the vaults, hideouts and ruins of Pheran, where everyone owes someone.

apps.name: Torchline
apps.short_description: The sun has fallen asleep. Carry the last ember of daylight in a single torch and lead a column of four east to the Tower of the Sleeping Sun. A fairy-tale, turn-based party RPG where your marching order is your formation — and whoever holds the torch decides what you see.

apps.name: TORNBLADE
apps.short_description: TORNBLADE is a dark action RPG that combines exploration of a mysterious world with brutal, challenging combat, inspired by the uncompromising spirit of classic games from the 80s and 90s and Slavic and Celtic mythology.

apps.name: TowerMouth I
apps.short_description: Couch co-op bullet heaven inside a tower that talks back. Two knights on one screen - or online with Remote Play Together - climb twenty floors on the clock to its mouth, then fall into endless HELL. Your weapons fire themselves: you hop walls, stack cards into absurd builds and get mocked.

apps.name: Trashake
apps.short_description: Trashake is a chaotic junkyard cafe simulator! Dig through piles of garbage, collect fresh trash, and feed it to eternally hungry pigeon customers. Upgrade your skills, expand your territory, and unlock new dumpster delicacies. Become the King of the Dump!

apps.name: Tutsak
apps.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

apps.name: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
apps.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

apps.name: Undersea: Waves and Adventures
apps.short_description: You are the captain of a submarine of a small Ukrainian island state, with a big baggage of dreams and a lot of problems. Sink enemy ships, explore mysterious abandoned bases, steal secret documents. Drink tea and don't forget to have fun. Your team is already waiting for you. To the Battle!

apps.name: Unextinct
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

apps.name: Universal Chess
apps.short_description: A standalone chess system on an 8×8 board. King and Queen with equal or alternating sovereign powers, new heavy pieces, 192 symmetrical setups, diarchic or monarchical regimes and standard or enhanced movement. Martial Rule and Atomic Permutation. Play vs. AI, 2P on one PC, or AI vs. AI.

apps.name: Urban Echoes
apps.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

apps.name: Utopia '97
apps.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

apps.name: Velvet Rope: Nightlife Manager
apps.short_description: Manage your own nightclub in this 2D management sim. Hire staff, set prices, handle troublesome guests, upgrade your venues and keep the party running while turning each night into a profitable business.

apps.name: VOXHELL
apps.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

apps.name: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy organizing sim for 1–4 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys — egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more — onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

apps.name: Wanderer Wheels
apps.short_description: Take a relaxing road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, visit small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

apps.name: Ways Unknown
apps.short_description: Piece together ancient secrets hidden in plain sight in this surreal open-world mystery set in a strange desert.

apps.name: Whodunit Sudoku
apps.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

apps.name: Wholesaler Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own wholesale business in Wholesaler Simulator! Negotiate with producers, stock products in your warehouse, and fulfill online orders. Upgrade your warehouse, hire workers, and buy new vehicles. Manage deliveries and grow your business in this realistic trading simulation!

apps.name: WildScore
apps.short_description: Take coins, buy animal cards, and race to the winning score. WildScore is a turn-based tabletop game in a sunlit courtyard. Play solo against bots, pass-and-play locally, or invite a friend on Steam. Up to four players.

apps.name: Wildsite
apps.short_description: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

apps.name: WonderPaws
apps.short_description: Welcome to WonderPaws! Where a city is built by animals! Here Paw Pals run shops, make friends, and chase their dreams. You, a newly arrived human, get a whimsical new life: share a home with Paw Pals, decorate it, become a star, mayor, or designer… or turn into a Paw Pal yourself and try it all!

apps.name: You Got Me Killed!
apps.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

apps.name: You Said Last Wave
apps.short_description: “Didn't you say this was the last wave?” The guns are still firing as another horde scales the wall. Auto-battling meets tower defense: combine machine guns, shotguns, fire, and chain lightning while your soldiers fight on their own. Can your setup hold until the last wave?

apps.name: YOUR DEAD WEIGHT
apps.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror-comedy for up to 6 players. Move the furniture out before time runs out, or become the thing that won't let it leave.

apps.name: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
apps.short_description: Run a corporate office in Hell. Hire, customize, and assign imployees, reject petty sinners, automate absurd punishments, and climb the infernal corporate ladder in this comedic incremental management game.

apps.name: Zombies & Battery
apps.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

apps.name: [Hell is Empty]
apps.short_description:
The Playground beckons you. Play as Dreadnaught: A hulking monstrosity meant to destroy everything in his path. But when he finds a damaged robot named Miss Sunshine...something within him snaps. And now Miss Sunshine might be the only one who's safe.
[A Visual Novel]

apps.name: ‌Super Puzzle‌
apps.short_description: A feature-packed casual jigsaw puzzle game! Enjoy multiple difficulties, real-time multiplayer battles, Workshop custom images, desktop pets, rhythm mini-games, and story mode. 9 languages, 22 Steam achievements!

apps.name: かぼちゃのトロワ
apps.short_description:
Take control of Torowa the pumpkin and challenge all 40 stages!
Stomp on monsters to defeat them, collect candies, and aim for a high score by defeating monsters in the specified order during Night Mode!

apps.name: ねこ天下～三国志パチンコタイピングで轟かす～
カエルvsヒツジ娘
apps.short_description: A mini 3D action game where you fight a giant sheep girl

apps.name: ソラの教室 : Classroom in Sora
apps.short_description: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

apps.name: ダイノボックス
apps.short_description:
Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger!
DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

apps.name: プールサイドの記憶
apps.short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. Scattered memories, multiple endings — and a world that rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

apps.name: 你的“那个”
apps.short_description:
Finally, you can grow your own little thing.

Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief.

How big will yours get?

apps.name: 坤坤商店大整理
apps.short_description: An organizing game made exclusively for IKUNs! After a chaotic "Sing, Dance, Rap" incident, 3400 KunKun figures are scattered everywhere. Sort all 30 types back onto their shelves, earn rewards, and unlock new skills. No timers, no quotas—pure relaxing fun!

apps.name: 山河念远
apps.short_description: 民国十三年，顾念之为摆脱包办婚姻孤身南下。她以为逃离牢笼便能获得自由，可等待她的，是码头的骗局、工厂女工的血泪、军阀混战的硝烟，以及三个截然不同的男人……可在这山河破碎的年代，当一个女人想要主宰自己的命运时，她要付出什么样的代价？

apps.name: 巡查員：異常報告
apps.short_description: Memorize things and look for anomalies, but you have to keep walking around in the scene. At the end of a level, there will even be a huge monster chasing you, and by the time you finish a level, half your fingers will be sore.

apps.name: 我在宗门寻长生
apps.short_description: Begin anew each season in a cultivation RPG. Join four sects, master techniques, battle bosses, explore secret realms, grow herbs, craft treasures, raise spirit pets, and trade with players. Levels and gear reset, while pets, cosmetics, tokens, and titles carry over.

apps.name: 方块战舰: Module Warship
apps.short_description: In 方块战舰：Module Warship, you command the fleet and design the ships.This 2D space sandbox rejects pre-set hulls, offering extreme DIY freedom instead. Assemble dozens of functional modules to craft your ultimate warship from scratch, then lead your custom fleet to conquer the unknown depths of space.

apps.name: 星河仙道 Immortal Path
apps.short_description: this is a systemic, 2D open-world sandbox Cultivation (Xianxia) game. Beyond static scripts, you’ll inhabit a living universe where everything is interactive and evolving in real-time. Experience alchemy, beast taming, and flight, while truly reshaping a dynamic world driven by a chain of causality.

apps.name: 星萌EV
